title: SENA Production Page Contract
description: Static contract for the local production smoke test and reviewer handoff. Each required text item should be present in the built /workspace/sena page.

notes: This contract verifies demo-critical page affordances in the built production HTML.
It is a smoke contract for local demo readiness, not a full visual regression suite.

The C3 workspace shell checks preserve the ENA-inspired workbench structure: left Sets/Model/Plot Tools/Stats rail, dominant central plot deck, collapsed plot switcher, and right-side Primary/Secondary plot viewports.
The Stats provenance checks keep metric values tied to direct jSNA, jENA, SENA-implemented, and composite source categories before interpretation.
The central Fusion analysis-scope checks make the default plot auditable as the active temporal-window model rather than an unscoped full-conversation graphic.
The central Fusion transition-delta checks keep adjacent-window S/W/B/G/A_fusion changes visible in the main plot surface for temporal interpretation.
The central Fusion G-pair shift checks expose the strongest person-code-pair explanation for adjacent-window change while preserving the non-causal interpretation guardrail.
The pilot asset checks keep the downloadable manifest, lesson-study sample files, and blank templates visible and reachable from Data Import.
The pilot handoff checks keep the Data Import entrypoint aligned with manifest-declared reviewer checks for model JSON, local runtimes, and review packet audit.
The center-region checks protect against the black-circle fusion-canvas regression observed during local review and preserve a stable SVG hook for future rendered-browser smoke tests.

The ENA solid-link and SNA outer-orbit checks preserve the adopted A1 Inner Solid Mesh visual grammar: S is an outer social arc, W is an inner solid concept mesh, and B remains a translucent bridge ribbon.
The readable link halo and label-plate checks preserve day-mode readability so labels and solid S/W/B paths remain legible over the grid.
The A1 layer-key checks keep the visible research legend aligned with the adopted S/W/B/G visual grammar and the active alpha/beta/gamma/threshold settings.
The runtime alignment chain check keeps the local JavaScript runtime story visible from five-table import through jENA, jSNA, SENA fusion, and review handoff.
The jENA concept-pair handoff checks keep the SENA W concept matrix visibly tied to jENA adjacency coverage and positive connection-count overlap without claiming W-weight equality.

The edge matrix provenance checks ensure selected graph relations can be traced to a runtime source, matrix block, formula factor, fusion slot, matrix fingerprint, evidence, and interpretation guardrail.
The concept-edge G attribution checks expose SENA's person-code-pair explanation for traditional ENA W concept links.
The Temporal Fusion Arc check preserves the adopted temporal visual direction for narrating lesson-study movement across Plan, Teach, and Reflect windows.
The temporal window fingerprint checks keep each Plan-Teach-Reflect window tied to stable S/W/B/G/A_fusion matrix checksums.
The G pair metric checks keep the temporal view aligned with the full S/W/B/G mathematical frame rather than only S/W/B summary metrics.
The claim-readiness checks keep research-use status visible: SENA outputs remain exploratory until human review and automated data/runtime/math/evidence/method gates all pass.

The review-packet audit checks keep the visible handoff panel aligned with the exported review packet, including project snapshot model JSON coverage, development-plan scope coverage, and method protocol companion-artifact coverage.
